titleEn: Buy more AI requests for my store

undo.note: a pack is not refunded automatically and does not renew

en: I hit the daily AI limit
How do I get more AI requests?

steps: Open Billing, then Add-ons, then More AI requests (or press Get more requests on AI usage)
Choose a pack, read the exact total, press Yes, charge
The new daily limit applies as soon as the payment is confirmed
edgeCases: A pack raises only your store's own daily limit for 30 days; the platform-wide daily and monthly limits still apply
Packs add up while they run
The token budget of your store grows by the same factor
Remaining requests for today are shown on AI usage and on Add-ons
